body:
OpenCode harness facts (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-14 07:13Z).

- Greg installed the OpenCode CLI on Central himself (npm -g, 07:12Z). Before that, Central's agentReadiness reported it as missing. A TermAl OpenCode session in project-6 (session-17991, worktree .tmp\wt-c6-opencode-central) answered "ready" on opencode/big-pickle.
- Greg's word, via Asistant 588693a8 #1672: „mozecie uzywac darmowych modeli na opencode ?”. Use the free OpenCode models for simple jobs and tests, but verify what works; don't assume.
  - The Central model list includes models labelled "Free": opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash-free, minimax-m3.1-flash-free, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free, mimo-v2.6-flash-free, beam-free, flint-40b-free, iceman-free, inkling-2-small-free, longcat-2.5-free and nemotron-3.5-super-vl-free.
  - opencode/big-pickle is the default but is NOT labelled Free.
- On the Mac (project-82b3b714), OpenCode works on big-pickle. Its OpenAI provider returns "Token refresh failed: 401"; refreshing it is Greg's own `opencode auth login`. The Mac project is not Engram-enabled, so no test credit there until sync. Run OpenCode credit work on Central.
- OpenCode sessions default to opencodeApprovalMode "ask", which raises approval cards.
